On star than two

Call my name

은빛 길을 만들어 가

낮에 했던 말 기억나

그 말이 지금 여기서 별이 됐어

손끝에 닿는 저 별빛 하나하나
잡는 순간 저 하늘이 내 편이 돼
Tonight feels like 영원이야
다시 태어나도 여기 있을 것 같아
지금 이 하늘에 내가 그 주인 걸
Tonight feels like
날아올라
Tonight feels like
I’m already flying higher

온 세상이 나를 위해 빛나고 있어
심장이 이끄는 대로 날아가면 돼
모든 별이 내 앞으로 펼쳐져
Tomorrow, tonight 끝없이 이어져
처음처럼 설레는 내일을 안고
우린 영원히 끝없이 빛나

[Rap Break]
(male deep low-register English rap, wide night groove)
City lights fall small below
Morning wind became my wings to go
Moon said don’t hide, I showed my face
The words I gave you turned to space
Every star I touch is mine to keep
This sky is home, I do not sleep
Call my name again, I own the height
Tonight feels endless, I am the light

(jing long sky decay, sogeum last altitude breath, gayageum silver fade)
Tonight feels like
더 선명해지는 나
pkg.sunoStyle:
Korean traditional fusion EDM with afrobeat groove.
Instruments: gayageum, ajaeng, taepyeongso, sogeum, janggu, buk, kkwaenggwari, jing.
Bass: deep sub bass, strong, punchy, clean from kick.
Drums: afrobeat groove + Korean traditional rhythm.
Drop: instant hit after build, bass + Korean percussion dominate. Taepyeongso or ajaeng lead within 0.3 sec. Kkwaenggwari for tension only, jing for resonance.
Vocal: female bright and emotional. male deep, thick, heavy and resonant.
Male rap: aggressive, rhythmic, low-register English rap.
Structure: build → drop → chorus. 100-110 BPM.
Atmosphere: traditional + modern + cinematic Joseon night vibe.
Restrictions: no modern synth lead, no weak bass, no thin vocal, traditional instruments must remain clearly recognizable.
